answer: To keep sockpuppets expensive, every attestation must spend a small bonded pulse of spendable stake that remains locked until a later audit window closes. Attestors are sampled only from lineages that do not share a recent invite ancestor, so a farm cannot grade itself. When many new addresses drain into one operator, like streams vanishing into a karst cave, the protocol treats them as one identity and slashes the common relic of locked collateral. Replicas then inherit the penalty instead of minting fresh reputation.
